name: Argent-style smart wallet system — product identity unresolved
summary: An Ethereum wallet incident is reported to involve unsafe recovery-period configuration and repeated acceptance of signed actions. The reported loss is approximately USD 59,800; deployment identity, causal source and economic impact remain unverified by Hindsight. The description does not establish a compromise of the official Argent product.

primary_sources.summary: Security-researcher write-up with Ethereum transaction and module references; describes recovery-delay arithmetic and signature-replay concerns, attributing the initial alert to SlowMist.

coverage_gaps: Two transaction hashes and two candidate victim wallets were extracted from the researcher report links on a follow-up pass. Explorer state and incident-time code remain independently unverified.
Ethereum-mainnet and Solidity scope are source-reported. Recover historical module implementations and compiler settings before confirming source-level causality.
Repeated calls alone do not prove signed-message replay, recovery-deadline overflow or an owner change; inspect decoded traces and state transitions.
Official product identity is unresolved. Do not attribute this incident to Argent's official wallet.
Reported loss requires reconciliation with net asset movements and any recovery. Earliest disclosure, family assignment, source rights and human adjudication remain unresolved.
